sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_violations, MIN(case_date) AS min_date, MAX(case_date) AS max_date, SUM(CASE WHEN lon IS NULL OR lat IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_location FROM MONTGOMERY_READY.code_violations_2025
SELECT geoid, tract_name, population, code_violations_2025, violations_per_1000 FROM MONTGOMERY_READY.tract_violations ORDER BY violations_per_1000 DESC LIMIT 5
